a0d7c4f5:  ;This program is used to define deficiencies for multiple divisions.
 ;It allows the user to select divisions, types of deficiencies, and
 ;other parameters to generate reports.
e0e695b7: ;If multiple divisions are selected, proceed with division selection.
6a569145: ;If not using multiple divisions, default to the first division in the file.
14dee6d6: ;Execute the selected deficiency list type logic.
a2229520: ;Prompt for date range for the report, exit if not selected.
f491aeee: ;Select the deficiency types to include in the report.
b482214a: ;Ask additional report-specific questions.
59185a38: ;Inform the user that the report requires a wide format.
d75e20aa: ;Set the report run date and time to now.
a3367fcd: ;Prepare variables for the report and initiate the device handler.
b873b918: ;Exit the routine.
b4043d24: ;Start the main report loop, iterating through deficiencies.
290ba0f9: ;If generating a Physician or Combined report and there are records, proceed to the report generation logic for those types.
5c72aca2: ;If generating a Service report and there are records, proceed to the report generation logic for that type.
cbc61bb6: ;Display message if no records match the selection criteria.
43c20438: ;Exit the program.

 ;This part handles the logic to filter and set service-related information
 ;for the report based on patient movement and division settings.
58349935: ;Set the current admission or transfer to analyze.
c7b3bedb: ;Ensure the movement exists and find the corresponding stay or transfer.
1c1d35b4: ;Retrieve ward information.
ea992790: ;If a valid ward is found, set the division for the ward.
b08e3e20: ;Retrieve division specific information.
db7b8c3d: ;Set the service variable based on the ward's service section.
8a9920f2: ;Ensure service variable is set, defaulting if necessary.
e870a2be: ;Set the specialty variable, filtering out if not selected.
7120bf4a: ;Exit the service specific parameter processing.
ab1e46ba: ;Check division selection against the record's division.
3b4276b3: ;Filter out records not matching the selected division.
6cbd2e5b: ;Exclude records if division excludes 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' status and it matches.
c8af8d7c: ;Exclude records if division excludes 'REVIEWED' status and it matches.
c3d11362: ;Exclude records with 'COMPLETED' status.
f103b66b: ;Clear temporary variables.
4fa95cc0: ;Exclude records without a corresponding patient movement, if required.
c5945b5a: ;Exclude records with a corresponding patient movement, if required.
16eb8d53: ;Filter based on selected deficiency types.
d1c90f6a: ;Exclude records outside of the selected date range.
fe374bad: ;For Physician reports, filter based on selected physicians.
71900f58: ;For Patient reports, filter based on selected patients.
5e27c8ac: ;Exclude summary records if not in 'To Be Dictated' status, based on settings.
7925b223: ;Set up division totals and prepare division names for display.
445a7f97: ;Prepare patient identifiers for the report.
14e1f7d3: ;For Physician reports, organize records by physician.
51f45ebc: ;For Patient reports, organize records by patient.
37c41a38: ;For Service reports, set service and specialty variables for organizing.
c6f684ec: ;Filter services based on selections, preparing for display.
6a543a6e: ;Filter specialties based on selections, preparing for display.
6816afd1: ;Exit the check routine if the record is filtered out.
76819843: ;For Service reports, organize records by service and specialty.
4d179b34: ;Exit the check routine.

7f679d24: ;Exit the physician selection subroutine.
941c9c71: ;Invoke patient selection logic.

a28d0375: ;Set up service selection for the report.
d5756d9a: ;Set up specialty selection for the report.
